record.title: Derive and pin the complete stock ADC initialization transcript
record.intent: Validate one whole software-determined region with explicit live-binding and shadow-state conditions.
requirements: Use Kotlin tooling to read the pinned stock ELF and validate table symbols, relocations, loop bound, complete tail and command-construction instruction assumptions without modifying stock inputs.
Derive exactly452 ordered words:440 from the first110 entries of the two111-entry tables, four constant tail writes, and eight conditional initialized-shadow writes.
Preserve the distinction between immutable table predictions and writable-state assumptions; include expected table, function and shadow bindings plus initialized and final ADC shadow values.
Document a bounded versioned guest input protocol and emit deterministic stock and private-control fixtures with hashes. Authored review manifests use TOML.
Compare all452 words with independent static evidence and retain earlier analysis failures separately.
Commit and push the derivation conclusion before implementing the guest consumer.
acceptance: Reproducible derivation, exact bounds, binding and software-state conditions and input integrity are independently verified; no guest run or new modeled response in this task.
